body: api_push.go: handlePushTest gets device token from IDUNA for mjolnir-emily, fires test FCM notification. Returns 503 if FCM not configured, 404 if no token registered (S32-01 needed), 502 on FCM error. Wired as POST /api/v1/emily/push/test. Ready for S32-01 human action (register FCM token).
